verdict.rationale: The MCP server docs state agents can only query 'a designated set of Marqeta's Core API endpoints' (marqeta-docs-11), implying some built-in scoping of agent access, and Marqeta documents spend/velocity/merchant controls that limit what actions are permitted (marqeta-docs-5, marqeta-docs-6, marqeta-docs-13). However, there is no explicit documentation of an API-key/OAuth scoping mechanism letting a developer mint least-privilege credentials specifically for an agent — the scoping described is fixed by Marqeta's MCP server design, not a user-configurable credential-issuance feature. Missing for 10: explicit API credential/token scoping API or docs, user-configurable permission grants for agent identities, and independent verification of least-privilege enforcement.
